user.title: iPad MQTT Dashboard
user.description: Panels appear here on their own: in the iPad app's Settings enter your MQTT broker and a panel name (for example kitchen), and the panel registers when it connects. Then design its layout in the dashboard editor (integration options > Open the dashboard editor).

abort.single_instance_allowed: iPad MQTT Dashboard is already set up. Panels are added automatically when the app connects.

abort.no_devices: No panel has connected yet. Open the app on the iPad; it registers when it connects to the broker.
abort.not_loaded: The integration isn't loaded; reload it and try again.

editor.title: Dashboard editor
editor.description:
Design your panels' layouts in the editor, then press **Deploy** to send a profile to a panel.

**[Open the dashboard editor]({url})**

It runs inside Home Assistant using your login (admin only). It isn't in the sidebar unless you switch that on below; otherwise reach it from here or from a panel's device page (Visit).
